notes.title: The Abandoned Presence Kickstarter is Now Live
notes.content:
After working for more than 16 months on The Abandoned presence, the demo is now ready for you to play! 

I am part, the solo developer behind The Abandoned presence. It is inspired by own city and its heritage presented in a ruins imagination. The demo aims to establish the premise of the overall game, giving you a glimpse of all the mechanics you can expect. Currently, The Abandoned presence is far from the final version. Hence, I need all your support to continue this exciting journey and eventually deliver a polished game and fully realised world, inspired by urban India. 

[previewyoutube=eXFZ2_gHne0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game will develop and update as we advance. The demo is only the first chapter of the game. The whole story combines many more chapters. Please give any feedback, the game might have bugs and errors that I have not encountered yet. Extend your support by backing us on our Kickstarter campaign. 

Thank you so much. I am excited and grateful for your support.

Support The Abandoned Presence here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/theabandonedpresence/the-abandoned-predence
